item.title: Kennedy offers federal support to New York over measles outbreak
item.description: New York Governor Kathy Hochul spoke with U.S. Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. on Tuesday, and he offered federal support as the state responds to a measles outbreak, the Department of Health and Human Services said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: New York Governor Kathy Hochul spoke with U.S. Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. on Tuesday, and he offered federal support as the state responds to a measles outbreak, the Department of Health and Human Services said on Wednesday. Kennedy connected Hochul with Centers for Disease Control and Prevention Director Erica Schwartz, while federal health officials stand ready to support New York's outbreak response, HHS said. Speaking at the Wall Street Journal's Future of Health conference in Washington on Wednesday, Schwartz said Hochul had contacted Kennedy about the outbreak and that he gave her Schwartz's contact information. She did not provide further details. Hochul's office and the New York State Department of Health did not immediately respond to a request for comment. New York declared a statewide disaster emergency over a measles outbreak earlier this week, seeking to expand access to vaccination and contain the spread of the highly contagious disease. The state [USN:L4N45R1BM TEXT:"reported 108 measles cases through Oct. 3"], including 92 cases reported since July 15 in under-immunized rural communities across 18 counties, according to the governor's office. Schwartz recommended the measles, mumps and rubella (MMR) vaccine. CDC assistance has become politically charged under Kennedy, who has questioned measles-related deaths reported by states. Pennsylvania, with more than 1,000 cases this year, has resisted seeking CDC help after Kennedy disputed the virus's role in deaths there in a heated social media exchange with Democratic Governor Josh Shapiro. Texas and Virginia have sought CDC assistance.

item.title: Levi Strauss lifts annual profit outlook on tariff refunds, holiday demand
item.description: Levi Strauss raised its annual profit forecast on Wednesday, after benefiting from tariff refunds, as it bets on strong holiday demand for its premium denim.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Levi Strauss (LEVI.N) raised its annual profit forecast on Wednesday, after benefiting from tariff refunds, as it bets on strong holiday demand for its premium denim. Here are more details: The apparel brand received $79 million in refunds during the third quarter ended August 30 for tariffs paid under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act and plans to redeploy about $60 million this year on promotions and marketing However, comparable sales for its direct-to-consumer business were flat in the third quarter. CEO Michelle Gass said the business fell short of expectations with sales falling in the US as shoppers contended with higher inflation Still, the jeans maker's women's line has emerged as a bright spot, driven by demand for baggy jeans and a push beyond denim into tops, skirts and dresses Levi's raised its outlook for annual organic revenue growth to 6%, the upper end of its previous forecast of 5.5% to 6% The company's shares have fallen about 5% so far this year Net revenue for the quarter ended August 30 rose 4% to $1.61 billion, largely in line with estimates of $1.62 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG It earned 48 cents per share on an adjusted basis in the quarter, compared with analysts' estimate of about 36 cents per share

item.title: Com lances de quase R$3 bi, Petrobras arremata 12 blocos na Bacia de Campos
item.description: A Petrobras arrematou sozinha 12 blocos exploratórios na Bacia de Campos durante leilão da Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis (ANP), nesta quarta-feira, com a oferta de um total de aproximadamente R$2,97 bilhões em bônus de assinatura.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Petrobras (PETR3.SA) arrematou sozinha 12 blocos exploratórios na Bacia de Campos durante leilão da Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis (ANP), nesta quarta-feira, com a oferta de um total de aproximadamente R$2,97 bilhões em bônus de assinatura. Em cinco dos blocos arrematados, a companhia venceu uma disputa com um consórcio formado pela TotalEnergies e QatarEnergy. Ao realizar os principais lances no leilão, a Petrobras respondeu por quase todo o bônus arrecadado pelo governo com a venda de 48 blocos ao todo, segundo dados da ANP, que apontaram arrecadação total de pouco mais de R$3 bilhões.

item.title: Wall Street fecha em baixa, com rendimentos do Tesouro em alta
item.description: Wall Street fechou em baixa nesta quarta-feira, à medida que os rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro dos EUA de longo prazo retomaram sua alta, reacendendo os temores sobre a inflação e o aumento da dívida, um dia após o S&P 500 e o Nasdaq atingirem recordes de fechamento.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Culp, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
item.content:encoded: Wall Street fechou em baixa nesta quarta-feira, à medida que os rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro dos EUA de longo prazo retomaram sua alta, reacendendo os temores sobre a inflação e o aumento da dívida, um dia após o S&P 500 e o Nasdaq atingirem recordes de fechamento. Os três principais índices acionários dos EUA registraram quedas modestas, com o S&P 500 e o Dow posicionados para interromper suas sequências de quatro dias de alta. O Nasdaq caminhava para seu primeiro dia de queda em seis. O Russell 2000, índice de pequenas capitalizações (.RUT) , apresentou desempenho inferior ao das empresas de maior capitalização. Na esteira da alta do mercado de ações na terça-feira, o petróleo Brent ultrapassou brevemente a marca de US$100 por barril, e o rendimento dos títulos do Tesouro de 30 anos atingiu a maior alta em 24 anos. Preocupações com o abastecimento relacionadas à guerra no Irã têm levado à alta vertiginosa dos preços do petróleo, o que, por sua vez, reacendeu os temores de inflação e aumentou as chances de um ciclo prolongado de aumentos nas taxas de juros pelo banco central. Essas preocupações, combinadas com os crescentes níveis de endividamento corporativo e soberano, causaram uma onda de vendas de títulos globais, o que abalou os mercados globais nas últimas semanas. De acordo com dados preliminares, o S&P 500 (.SPX) perdeu 0,23%, fechando em 7.801,15 pontos, enquanto o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) recuou 0,24%, para 27.533,39 pontos. O Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) caiu 0,69%, para 51.165,37 pontos.

item.title: Fed minutes show some officials want to prepare for market stress
item.description: Federal Reserve meeting minutes from last month’s policy meeting noted some officials believe it’s time for the central bank to get ready for bond market stress.
item.dc:creator: Michael Derby
item.content:encoded: Federal Reserve meeting minutes from last month’s policy meeting noted some officials believe it’s time for the central bank to get ready for bond market stress. “Regarding balance sheet policy, a few participants observed that Treasury markets had been functioning smoothly but noted the importance of planning for market stress,” the [USN:L6N45T0TQ TEXT:"minutes"] from the central bank’s September 15-16 Federal Open Market Committee meeting said. These unnamed central bankers “suggested strengthening the Federal Reserve's strategy, communications, and tools for addressing market dysfunction, should it occur, while limiting the Federal Reserve's footprint in the Treasury market.” Those comments came from minutes that described central bank deliberations during a period of market unrest. Officials raised rates at last month’s meeting, boosting them by a quarter percentage point to between 3.75% and 4%, as they tightened policy to contend with high levels of inflation. Officials also penciled in another rate increase by year’s end. The shift in the path of monetary policy has been attended by a sharp rise in government bond yields that breached key levels and generated notable real-world increases in things like [USN:L6N45S1BF TEXT:"mortgage borrowing costs"]. Fed officials have been attributing the rise in yields to a solid economic outlook, the impact of strong tech investment that’s caused government yields to rise to compete for investment, and geopolitical concerns. That said, the power of the move has caused some to worry about the state of the market in a time of huge government deficits and ongoing worries about the outlook for inflation. These worries brush up against the Fed’s balance sheet because in the last two decades the central bank has addressed big periods of market stress with bond buying. The Fed dealt with the initial phases of the COVID-19 pandemic with big purchases of Treasury and mortgage debt before it transitioned those operations to a form of stimulus, for example. BALANCE SHEET BALANCING ACT That kind of buying swells the size of the Fed’s balance sheet. But new Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh is opposed to large Fed holdings and would like the balance sheet to be [USN:S8N40E0AX TEXT:"smaller"]. He’s named a task force to consider ways that might make that happen. The comment in the meeting minutes “sounds like an oblique way to draw a line in the sand and signal to the market and the White House that the Fed's thinking has not changed: It would intervene only if policy transmission is threatened, not simply because yields are rising rapidly,” said Derek Tang, an analyst at Monetary Policy Analytics, Inc. He added that even if the Fed does step in, it would use tools like its liquidity-providing standing repo operations and the discount window as its first line of defense against an unsettled market. Notably, those two tools are in place and are essentially on autopilot, ready to respond to market needs as they emerge. Meanwhile, Gennadiy Goldberg, head of US rates strategy at TD Securities, said he sees the comment from the minutes directed at managing technical Treasury bill buying aimed at bolstering reserve levels. “Given that we tend to see some stresses heading into year-end, this may be the discussion of resuming [Reserve Management Purchases] in the next few months,” he said, adding, “we think the Fed may resume RMP at a modest pace before year-end to ensure everything is functioning smoothly.“ In an interview last week, Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari cast doubt on the need for any broad central bank involvement in the bond market in the current situation. “I see every indication that the Treasury market is functioning fine, so I'm not seeing a financial stability risk, and I don't see any reason why the Fed would intervene, given that the market appears to be functioning just fine,” the official said.

item.title: GRANOS Maíz y soja caen tras alcanzar máximos de una semana por avance cosecha, se esperan datos USDA
item.description: Los futuros del maíz y la soja de Chicago cayeron el miércoles desde sus máximos de una semana, presionados por la cosecha en expansión del Medio Oeste, la fortaleza del dólar y a la espera de los informes mensuales sobre la oferta y la demanda de cultivos del Departamento de Agricultura, dijeron analistas.
item.dc:creator: Julie Ingwersen
item.content:encoded: Los futuros del maíz y la soja de Chicago cayeron el miércoles desde sus máximos de una semana, presionados por la cosecha en expansión del Medio Oeste, la fortaleza del dólar y a la espera de los informes mensuales sobre la oferta y la demanda de cultivos del Departamento de Agricultura, dijeron analistas. Los futuros del trigo cayeron más de un 2% debido a las ventas técnicas y a la incertidumbre sobre la demanda, mientras la moneda estadounidense se fortalecía. El contrato de maíz de diciembre de la Bolsa de Chicago cayó 6 centavos, o un 1,2 %, a 5,02 dólares el bushel, y el de soja de noviembre bajó 5,5 centavos, o un 0,4%, a 12,9750 dólares el bushel. El trigo de diciembre de la CBOT cedió 17,75 centavos, o un 2,5%, a 6,8650 dólares el bushel. El maíz y la soja bajaron mientras las cosechadoras recorrían el Medio Oeste bajo un cielo mayormente despejado, reanudando las labores del campo tras las fuertes lluvias de finales de septiembre que habían frenado el avance. Los mercados al contado del Medio Oeste para ambos cultivos se han mostrado débiles esta semana, al aumentar las ventas de los agricultores. "Estamos entrando en una fase de cosecha intensiva", afirmó Don Roose, presidente de U.S. Commodities, y añadió que los operadores están siguiendo de cerca los informes de rendimiento de los campos a la espera de los informes de oferta y demanda del Departamento de Agricultura (USDA) el viernes, que incluirán estimaciones actualizadas para EEUU. Los analistas encuestados por Reuters esperan, de media, que el USDA rebaje su estimación del rendimiento medio del maíz en EEUU, mientras que mantendrá sin cambios su previsión sobre el rendimiento de la soja. Los futuros de harina de soja subieron, contrarrestando la tendencia a la baja del complejo de cereales y soja, ya que los operadores compraron harina de soja frente a los futuros de aceite de soja aprovechando los diferenciales. Las lluvias empaparon los cultivos maduros en algunas zonas del oeste del Medio Oeste el mes pasado, lo que suscitó preocupaciones sobre la calidad. Sin embargo, las inquietudes sobre el bajo contenido en aceite de la soja, que podría reducir la oferta de aceite de soja, parecieron disiparse el miércoles, a medida que las trituradoras nacionales evaluaban los suministros de soja entrantes. Los futuros del trigo en la CBOT bajaron después de que el contrato de referencia de diciembre alcanzara su precio más alto desde el 25 de septiembre al inicio de la sesión. "Hay suficiente trigo en el mercado mundial como para que, cuando los precios se disparan, se pierda a los compradores que buscan valor", señaló Roose. Los operadores también sopesaban las perturbaciones que la guerra está causando en el comercio del Mar Negro frente a los indicios de un aumento de las exportaciones rusas a través de rutas alternativas por el Mar Báltico. Los precios del trigo habían subido el martes tras conocerse la noticia de que dos buques mercantes, incluido uno que transportaba cereales, habían sido alcanzados por un ataque con drones en el mar Negro, frente a las costas de Bulgaria. "Los operadores siguen tratando de evaluar si los ataques a buques cerca de Bulgaria y Rumania fueron una escalada puntual o el inicio de un riesgo más sistémico para los flujos del mar Negro", señaló Donatas Jankauskas, analista de CM Navigator.

item.title: FIFA says unpaid court sanction over alleged AI misuse justifies tossing antitrust lawsuit
item.description: Soccer's global governing body FIFA has urged a federal judge in Puerto Rico to dismiss an antitrust lawsuit after lawyers for the plaintiffs were sanctioned over court filings with defective legal citations that a judge said bore hallmarks of AI misuse.
item.dc:creator: Mike Scarcella
item.content:encoded: Soccer's global governing body FIFA has urged a federal judge in Puerto Rico to dismiss an antitrust lawsuit after lawyers for the plaintiffs were sanctioned over court filings with defective legal citations that a judge said bore hallmarks of AI misuse. Here are the details: FIFA, in a filing on Tuesday, said the case should be dismissed because the plaintiffs' lawyers have failed to pay the court-ordered sanction Chief US District Judge Raúl Arias-Marxuach in Puerto Rico last year awarded more than $24,400 in legal fees to FIFA and other defendants after finding the lawyers submitted filings with 55 erroneous citations that the court said appeared to be AI-generated The sanctioned attorneys, José Olmo-Rodríguez and Ibrahim Reyes, represent the Puerto Rico Soccer League in the lawsuit, which [USN:L2N3MX0VP TEXT:"alleges"] FIFA conspired to restrict tournaments and matches in the US territory. FIFA has denied any wrongdoing Olmo-Rodríguez and Reyes did not immediately respond to requests for comment. They have denied using AI to prepare their filings The plaintiffs’ attorneys asked the court to not dismiss the lawsuit, saying it would unfairly punish their client. "Counsel did not contest the award, nor its amount, nor represent that they would never pay it,” they said in a filing The case is Puerto Rico Soccer League NFP Corp et al v. Federación Puertorriqueña de Futbol et al, US District Court for the District of Puerto Rico, No. 3:23-cv-01203. item.title: LPGA's 2027 schedule increases purse by $10M, reduces travel by 12,000 miles
item.description: The LPGA announced its 2027 schedule on Wednesday, one that earned positive reviews when shared with the players in August.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The LPGA announced its 2027 schedule on Wednesday, one that earned positive reviews when shared with the players in August. The primary reasons the players celebrated the slate included an increase of the total purse from $137 to $147 million, 12,000 fewer miles traveled, two events in Hawaii, and visits to courses with added prestige. The tour revealed the schedule to the players during the week of the FM Championship in Boston at the end of August. "I've never seen players clap the way they clapped for this schedule," said Ricki Lasky, chief tour business and operations officer. "I had a lot of conversations after the meeting. They were thrilled. They appreciated the routing work which we did to make it more efficient for them as they move around the globe. "Obviously, they're excited about the purse growth and how meaningful that is and then the upgraded courses. I don't think that's lost on them. They want to play the best courses in the world. They're so talented and our fans want to see them play the best courses in the world." The 33-event campaign once again kicks off with the Hilton Grand Vacations Tournament of Champions at Lake Nona Golf & Country Club in Orlando during the first weekend in February, which is one week later than the 2026 edition was contested. A new tournament, the Futu Ladies World Championship will take place at Clearwater Bay in Hong Kong during the first week of March. That is followed by back-to-back tournaments in Hawaii. The second event, the Lotte Championship, has been moved from October to mid-March and will be played on the former PGA Tour course at Kapalua. It will combine both professional and collegiate players. The first of five majors will be the Chevron Championship from April 19-25. For the second consecutive year, it will be played at Memorial Park in Houston. The U.S. Women's Open will take place at Inverness Golf Club in Toledo, Ohio from May 31-June 6 and the KPMG Women's PGA Championship will be played at venerable Congressional CC outside of Washington, D.C three weeks later. The players head for Europe to compete in the Amundi Evian Championship at the Evian Resort Club in France (July 5-11), followed by the AIG Women's British Open at Royal St. George's Golf Club (July 26-August 1). Royal St. George's Golf Club, located 90 miles southeast of London, will host the women for the first time after the men's Open Championship has been contested 15 times. Collin Morikawa won the last edition in 2021. "Our schedule impacts every stakeholder, but our athletes remain at the heart of how we build it," said LPGA Tour commissioner Craig Kessler in a statement. "Our progress is evident in how our athletes and the entire LPGA ecosystem will move around the world next year, creating more opportunities to rest, recover and ultimately operate more efficiently. "The venues we play at matter, and we're adding even more courses that fans will love and recognize. Our players have earned the chance to compete on these stages, and we encourage fans to tune in to watch them do it. The prize fund reflects the incredible collaboration and support of our partners, who keep recognizing the value of our players. We know our players and fans care about all three of these things, and we can't wait to keep making even more progress in the years ahead." --Field Level Media

item.title: Dodgers shuffle Shohei Ohtani to cleanup spot in Game 4
item.description: For the third time in four playoff games, Los Angeles Dodgers designated hitter Shohei Ohtani has a new spot in the lineup.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: For the third time in four playoff games, Los Angeles Dodgers designated hitter Shohei Ohtani has a new spot in the lineup. Ohtani was in the cleanup spot for Wednesday's National League Division Series Game 4 on the road against the Atlanta Braves. Ohtani hit in the No. 2 spot for the first two games of the series at Los Angeles, then was dropped to fifth for Game 3 on Tuesday at Atlanta when the Dodgers finished off a 3-1 victory to take a 2-1 lead in the best-of-five series. It was the first time Ohtani batted lower than second since joining the Dodgers in 2024. Like in Game 3, Dodgers manager Dave Roberts had Mookie Betts batting leadoff followed by Freddie Freeman. Teoscar Hernandez was dropped from third to fifth for Game 4, while Will Smith moved up a spot to third in the order. Ohtani, 32, batted .275 with an .889 OPS, 30 home runs and 81 RBIs this season but has been bothered by right biceps and left knee discomfort during the second half of the season. Continued biceps soreness landed him on the injured list late in the regular season. Ohtani has not hit a home run since Aug. 18, a run of 21 games since he last went deep, including three games during the playoffs. He is 2-for-10 (.200) with one walk and three strikeouts in the division series, but did reach base on catcher's interference and a walk in Game 3. Ohtani last started a game in the cleanup spot during the 2022 season with the Los Angeles Angels. He has started just 35 games in the cleanup spot in nine major league seasons. --Field Level Media

item.title: Christa Pike está “irritada e confusa” após tentativa fracassada de execução no Tennessee, dizem advogados
item.description: Christa Pike, condenada à morte por um homicídio ocorrido em 1995, acordou “irritada e confusa” em um hospital nesta semana, com um longo período de recuperação pela frente, após ter sobrevivido à tentativa fracassada do Tennessee de executá-la, informaram seus advogados nesta quarta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Allen
item.content:encoded: Christa Pike, condenada à morte por um homicídio ocorrido em 1995, acordou “irritada e confusa” em um hospital nesta semana, com um longo período de recuperação pela frente, após ter sobrevivido à tentativa fracassada do Tennessee de executá-la, informaram seus advogados nesta quarta-feira. Há uma semana, Pike, de 50 anos, foi levada da câmara de execução para um hospital em Nashville, inconsciente, em estado crítico e com ferimentos graves nos braços, após duas injeções do barbitúrico cáustico pentobarbital que não resultaram em sua morte na Instituição de Segurança Máxima de Riverbend. Ainda na segunda-feira, seus advogados acreditavam que Pike encontrava-se com morte cerebral e que o suporte de vida seria desligado no dia seguinte, após a segunda execução mal sucedida no Tennessee neste ano, o que renovou o escrutínio sobre a pena de morte nos EUA. “Mas na terça-feira, para o choque de todos, incluindo eu, sua equipe e a equipe médica, Christa acordou e começou a falar”, disse a jornalistas um de seus advogados, Randall Spivey, após uma audiência nesta quarta-feira, na qual um juiz ordenou que as autoridades do Tennessee preservem as seringas e outras evidências da execução malsucedida. “Ela está com raiva e confusa com tudo neste momento”, disse Spivey. “Ela está plenamente ciente de que o Estado tentou executá-la.” O governador Bill Lee suspendeu todas as execuções até o final do ano, enquanto investigadores analisam as execuções malsucedidas de Pike e de Tony Carruthers, em maio, quando os funcionários da prisão não conseguiram instalar o acesso intravenoso. Pike continua muito doente e acorrentada à cama do hospital, enfrentando um longo caminho até a recuperação, disseram seus advogados. Ela não consegue engolir nem comer, tem pneumonia, não consegue mover as mãos e os braços “extremamente inchados” e não está claro se recuperará a mobilidade perdida, afirmaram. Embora ainda apresente “confusão cognitiva”, segundo os advogados, ela tem conversado com as pessoas ao seu redor. “Ela tem querido saber o que aconteceu e perguntou por várias pessoas”, disse Spivey. “Ela perguntou pela família da vítima”. Pike foi condenada à morte por seu papel, quando era adolescente, na tortura e assassinato, em 1995, de sua colega de escola Colleen Slemmer, de 19 anos. Ela é a primeira pessoa conhecida a ter sobrevivido a uma “tentativa de execução consumada” nos EUA, afirmam seus advogados, que consideram isso uma violação da proibição constitucional de punições cruéis e incomuns. CASO ÚNICO Os advogados de Pike estão, de forma inesperada, dando continuidade ao processo contra autoridades estaduais, buscando romper o sigilo que normalmente envolve os procedimentos de execução no Tennessee e em outros Estados. Na manhã desta quarta-feira, a juíza I’Ashea Myles, do Tribunal de Chancelaria do Condado de Davidson, concordou em ordenar que as autoridades do Tennessee preservem todas as evidências da execução fracassada, incluindo seringas, embalagens de medicamentos e números de lote, cateteres, linhas intravenosas e cintos de imobilização da maca. A equipe de execução composta exclusivamente por mulheres solicitada por Pike utilizou pelo menos sete agulhas durante uma provação exaustiva que durou mais de duas horas, e uma agulha estava dobrada em 90 graus quando foi retirada, afirmaram seus advogados. Myles concordou em grande parte com os advogados de Pike ao final da audiência desta quarta-feira, descrevendo o processo judicial -- que teve início em janeiro com o objetivo de impedir a execução -- como incomum, pois ninguém havia previsto que Pike sobreviveria. “Este caso é único, para dizer o mínimo”, disse Myles. Ela também ordenou que o Estado preserve as comunicações internas sobre a tentativa de execução, incluindo relatórios de incidentes, depoimentos de testemunhas e mensagens criptografadas. Ela ainda não se pronunciou sobre pedido dos advogados de Pike para que o Departamento Penitenciário do Tennessee lhes permita coletar quaisquer vestígios remanescentes das drogas de execução para análise química. O Departamento Correcional do Tennessee considerou a ordem de preservação “duplicada e desnecessária”, argumentando que já é legalmente obrigado a preservar todas as provas e que já estava disposto a compartilhar a maior parte, se não tudo, do que os advogados de Pike solicitaram. O Tennessee e outros Estados dos EUA há muito enfrentam dificuldades para adquirir drogas para execuções. Elas não podem ser obtidas junto às grandes empresas farmacêuticas devido a uma proibição comercial europeia que impede empresas de venderem produtos para uso em tortura ou execuções. O Tennessee, assim como outros Estados, recorreu a pequenas farmácias de manipulação, em grande parte não regulamentadas, para fabricar pequenos lotes dos medicamentos, prometendo ocultar sua identidade. “A audiência de hoje tratou de transparência, sobre por que Christa, os tribunais, a mídia e o público não deveriam simplesmente acreditar na versão do Estado sobre o que aconteceu na última quarta-feira”, disse Luke Ihnen, outro advogado de Pike. Ele reiterou a exigência de que o governador do Tennessee, Bill Lee, comute a pena de Pike para prisão perpétua e nunca mais tente executá-la. Um porta-voz de Lee, que negou um pedido de clemência dois dias antes da execução malsucedida, não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário. Os advogados de Pike haviam buscado uma alternativa à injeção letal, alegando que suas veias finas e condições médicas associadas a deixavam com medo de que algo desse errado.

item.title: Ronaldo elogia a Messi después de su despedida de la selección argentina
item.description: El capitán de Portugal, Cristiano Ronaldo, hizo a un lado el miércoles una de las grandes rivalidades del fútbol para rendir homenaje a Lionel Messi, que dijo que ya echaba de menos representar a Argentina tras su emotiva retirada de la selección.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El capitán de Portugal, Cristiano Ronaldo, hizo a un lado el miércoles una de las grandes rivalidades del fútbol para rendir homenaje a Lionel Messi, que dijo que ya echaba de menos representar a Argentina tras su emotiva retirada de la selección. Messi, de 39 años, ofreció el martes una última lección magistral con la camiseta albiceleste, marcando un gol y dando dos asistencias en la victoria 3-0 en un partido amistoso contra Benín ante más de 85.000 aficionados en el Estadio Monumental de Buenos Aires, donde su despedida se convirtió en una celebración de una extraordinaria carrera internacional de 21 años. "Ayer fue mi último partido y ya extraño vestir la celeste y blanca. Sé que estoy tomando la decisión correcta", escribió en una larga publicación en Instagram. "Fue un camino increíble, lleno de alegrías y también de algunas tristezas, pero tengo claro que valió la pena cada paso que di". "No quiero olvidarme del Diego (Maradona), que puso a nuestro país donde se merecía estar y que, como siempre digo, sé que nos ayudó estando acá con nosotros y también desde el cielo, en cada paso que dimos". "Gracias a los clubes en los que jugué, por respetar siempre mis sentimientos y permitirme dedicarme a mi país cuando tocaba ponernos la camiseta de la Selección", agregó. Messi capitaneó a Argentina hasta el título del Mundial de 2022 y en los triunfos en la Copa América de 2021 y 2024, además de ayudar al equipo a ganar la Finalísima de 2022. Messi y Ronaldo han competido por el reconocimiento como el mejor jugador de su generación durante sus largas y premiadas carreras, y el delantero portugués de 41 años fue uno de los que respondió a la publicación. "Leo, tantos años defendiendo a tu país y una historia que quedará para siempre. Todo mi respeto por lo que has logrado con Argentina. Un abrazo". Ronaldo, por su parte, se encuentra envuelto en una disputa con el seleccionador de Portugal, Jorge Jesús, tras su repentina salida de la concentración de la selección.

item.title: Operação da PF que mirou político do PL é de 2025 e não envolve Flávio
item.description: Publicações nas redes sociais compartilham uma reportagem sobre uma operação da Polícia Federal (PF) que teve entre os alvos um político do PL como se fosse recente e estivesse relacionada às atuais eleições, mas a matéria é de 2025 e não está associada ao candidato a presidente Flávio Bolsonaro (PL).
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Publicações nas redes sociais compartilham uma reportagem sobre uma operação da Polícia Federal (PF) que teve entre os alvos um político do PL como se fosse recente e estivesse relacionada às atuais eleições, mas a matéria é de 2025 e não está associada ao candidato a presidente Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). "Polícia Federal já começou cedo e tem um do PL envolvido. Eu avisei que Flávio Bolsonaro não tem condições de estar na frente do Lula, olha a prova aí", dizem os posts , que circulam no Facebook e no Threads. O conteúdo mostra um trecho de uma reportagem do Bom Dia Brasil, da TV Globo, sobre uma ação da PF que investigou a participação de empresários e políticos na produção de conteúdo falso para as redes sociais. Segundo a PF, os envolvidos pagavam atores para encenar cenas roteirizadas favoráveis a candidatos. No entanto, a matéria é de abril de 2025, mais de um ano antes da atual campanha presidencial, como mostra a íntegra do programa no Globoplay . A reportagem diz que o prefeito de Cabo Frio (RJ), Dr. Serginho (PL), e o ex-prefeito de Itaguaí (RJ) Rubem de Souza (Podemos) foram alvos de busca e apreensão pela PF em uma operação que também investigava caixa dois, fraudes em licitações e lavagem de dinheiro, entre outros crimes. Em nenhum momento Flávio é citado entre os envolvidos. Flávio venceu o primeiro turno das eleições presidenciais do último domingo com 47,03% dos votos válidos, à frente do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, que teve 45,16%. O segundo turno ocorre no próximo dia 25. VEREDICTO Enganoso. A reportagem sobre uma ação da PF contra um esquema de desinformação e lavagem de dinheiro é do ano passado e não menciona Flávio Bolsonaro. item.title: Whoa, Tide? Alabama, Georgia brace for tropical storm
item.description: A clash between two of college football's top programs could end up making a splash -- quite literally.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A clash between two of college football's top programs could end up making a splash -- quite literally. Saturday's matchup between No. 6 Alabama and No. 2 Georgia, at Tuscaloosa, Ala., is expected to be in the path of tropical storm Isaias, which continues to make its way north toward the Gulf Coast. As of now, the Alabama athletic department is saying this in a statement: "... there are no plans to alter the contest." According to The Weather Channel, there is a 96% chance of rain Saturday in the Tuscaloosa area with winds as high as 23 mph from the east-southeast. "You can't really practice conditions, you can't simulate them," Georgia head coach Kirby Smart said. "So, you're much better off to educate, learn from the past of other people that have played in them and prepare your team to play and not make it about that." Both teams have perfect 5-0 records this season, while each are 3-0 in SEC play. But Saturday's weather forecast throws an entirely different challenge into the mix for both teams. "I'm just getting our football team ready," Alabama head coach Kalen DeBoer said. "It hasn't affected us much other than we're doing the wet ball drills and getting wet ball involved with some of our team reps, just like we did last week at times, preparing for the rain a week ago." DeBoer said he has not heard of a plan to alter the schedule of Saturday's game by either moving it to Friday or possibly Monday, or even if there is any benefit to adjusting the scheduled 6:30 p.m. local kickoff time. Smart called the situation, "uncertainty beyond my control." Currently projected to become a hurricane over the next 24 hours, the storm is expected to revert back to a tropical storm by the time it reaches Tuscaloosa in the central part of the state. The storm is expected to make landfall as a hurricane somewhere between Louisiana and the Florida panhandle late Friday or early Saturday. "We will continue to observe conditions throughout the week and remain in communication with the Southeastern Conference office, as needed," the Alabama athletic department said in a statement. --Field Level Media

item.title: Anglo American ameaça fechar unidade de níquel no Brasil caso UE bloqueie a venda para MMG
item.description: A Anglo American provavelmente encerrará suas operações de níquel no Brasil caso os órgãos de defesas da concorrência da União Europeia bloqueiem a venda da unidade para a MMG , empresa de mineração e metais listada na bolsa de Hong Kong.
item.dc:creator: Yun Chee Foo
item.content:encoded: A Anglo American (AAL.L) provavelmente encerrará suas operações de níquel no Brasil caso os órgãos de defesas da concorrência da União Europeia bloqueiem a venda da unidade para a MMG (1208.HK) , empresa de mineração e metais listada na bolsa de Hong Kong. Essa será a advertência que seu diretor de operações fará aos reguladores em uma audiência a portas fechadas na quinta-feira, de acordo com comentários preparados obtidos pela Reuters. O diretor de operações da Anglo American Brasil, Ruben Fernandes, e Cristina Morgan, diretora financeira da empresa no Brasil, tentarão convencer a Comissão Europeia de que o negócio de US$500 milhões com a MMG não prejudicará os produtores europeus de aço inoxidável. A comissão, que é o órgão antitruste da UE, havia alertado no mês passado que a MMG poderia desviar o fornecimento da Europa, prejudicando seus produtores de aço inoxidável. O caso surge em meio a preocupações da UE com a dependência do bloco em relação à China no que diz respeito a minerais críticos. "A prolongada análise regulatória já causou considerável incerteza localmente, mas as consequências de a Comissão Europeia proibir a venda do negócio seriam muito preocupantes", dirá Fernandes aos reguladores, de acordo com declarações vistas pela Reuters. "Reconhecendo que a MMG é o único comprador confiável que identificamos e, dado nosso compromisso de sair do negócio de níquel há mais de dois anos, teremos poucas opções a não ser seguir o caminho da 'manutenção e conservação' como caminho para o fechamento, caso a Comissão proíba a venda à MMG", afirmará ele. De acordo com o texto preparado, ele dirá aos reguladores que é possível encontrar uma solução prática que atenda às preocupações da UE. Morgan destacará as credenciais da MMG como compradora confiável, que continuará atendendo aos clientes na Europa. "O processo de seleção analisou minuciosamente as capacidades operacionais do potencial licitante e seu histórico de atuação responsável, a capacidade de desenvolver projetos futuros e as intenções em relação aos nossos funcionários, o valor justo, bem como a capacidade de financiar a aquisição", ela dirá ao órgão regulador da UE. "A MMG é membro do ICMM, como nós, é bem conhecida por nós e possui esse histórico de ser uma operadora responsável e de oferecer valor concreto para o investimento", dirá ela, referindo-se ao órgão setorial Conselho Internacional de Mineração e Metais (ICMM). O gerente geral executivo de relações corporativas da MMG, Troy Hey, também estará presente na audiência para defender os méritos do negócio perante altos funcionários e advogados da Comissão.

item.title: Brazil's Bolsonaro pledges broad review of Lula-era taxes
item.description: Brazil presidential candidate Senator Flavio Bolsonaro said on Wednesday his team was studying constitutional amendments to revise parts of a planned consumption-tax reform — alongside other fiscal measures — arguing the current design would leave the country with an excessively high tax burden.
item.dc:creator: Marcela Ayres
item.content:encoded: Brazil presidential candidate Senator Flavio Bolsonaro said on Wednesday his team was studying constitutional amendments to revise parts of a planned consumption-tax reform — alongside other fiscal measures — arguing the current design would leave the country with an excessively high tax burden. "There are several constitutional amendments that are possible," Bolsonaro told reporters, citing "aspects of the tax reform" among measures he would pursue if elected, alongside lowering the age of criminal responsibility, ending presidential reelection and implementing a political reform. In 2023, leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva [USN:S0N3CA02R TEXT:"approved"] the consumption-tax reform, a long-awaited overhaul of Brazil's tax system, set to begin taking effect next year, which will consolidate multiple levies into a dual value-added tax administered at the federal and regional levels. "I support modernizing our tax system, which is genuinely too complex," Bolsonaro said. The reformed consumption tax's effective VAT rate — estimated to be about 28% by economists but not yet finalized by the government - would be too high, Bolsonaro said. Bolsonaro also said he wanted to reduce payroll taxes and ensure that "more of Brazilian workers' income stays with them rather than the government." On Tuesday, the senator's top economic adviser, Daniella Marques, told local media that a Bolsonaro administration would review a broad range of tax measures enacted under Lula, including a dividend tax that took effect in January. Marques served in the elder Bolsonaro's government. She said that administration had previously only proposed taxing dividends alongside a reduction in corporate income taxes. Bolsonaro would also eliminate the 12% tax on crude oil exports introduced this year by Lula's government, Marques said, describing the levy as an "aberration." Lula introduced the tax to help finance fuel-tax relief for Brazilians amid a global oil-price spike linked to the US-Israeli conflict on Iran. Other tax measures on the chopping block include reversing increases to the Financial Transactions Tax (IOF) on corporate credit operations, foreign-exchange transactions, and certain private pension investments, Marques said. By contrast, Lula's platform pledged to deepen efforts to promote "tax justice" and reduce inequality through the elimination of tax distortions and privileges, while implementing the consumption-tax overhaul approved during his administration. Lula this year introduced a tax on dividends to help finance an tax exemption on higher income for middle-income earners, while his administration has argued for further cuts to tax exemptions and the elimination of what it views as inefficient tax incentives. Bolsonaro, the eldest son of ex-President Jair Bolsonaro, outperformed expectations to finish [USN:L6N45Q04L TEXT:"ahead"] of leftist incumbent President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva in Sunday's first round. The rivals go head-to-head in an October 25 runoff. DEBT RESTRUCTURING Amid near-record levels of household debt in Brazil, Senator Bolsonaro also said his government would buy debt from over-indebted consumers and refinance it through state-owned lender Caixa Economica Federal. Borrowers would also gain access to new credit lines to help finance small businesses, he said. Lula, like Bolsonaro, has also [USN:L1N45H0UN TEXT:"pledged"] to purchase debt as part of a campaign promise. The government said it will hold an auction in November to buy and restructure household debt, spending 15 billion reais to acquire up to 150 billion reais of delinquent loans at discounts of at least 90%. The program is expected to cover about half of the debt stock deemed eligible. Households would then be able to clear overdue obligations at the discounted value, with the full benefit of the write-down passed through to borrowers.

item.title: Christian Dior board replaces two members ahead of new shareholding structure
item.description: French luxury company Christian Dior said on Wednesday it replaced two independent board members ahead of a change of shareholding structure planned by the family of billionaire Bernard Arnault.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: French luxury company Christian Dior (DIOR.PA) said on Wednesday it replaced two independent board members ahead of a change of shareholding structure planned by the family of billionaire Bernard Arnault. Xavier Musca, a former top executive at Credit Agricole, and Tony Estanguet, who led the committee in charge of the Paris Olympics in 2024, will replace Nicolas Bazire and Maria Luisa Loro Piana, effective immediately, the company said. The Arnault family, which controls Dior and French luxury behemoth LVMH (LVMH.PA) through its holding company Agache, said last month it plans to merge it with Dior. Agache currently owns 96% of Dior shares and 97.1% of the voting rights in Christian Dior and 6.77% in LVMH and 8.49% of the voting rights in LVMH. The merged entity will be named Agache and it will control directly 49.76% in LVMH and 65.55% of voting rights. The merger, expected in December, is set to include a tender offer for the 2.44% of the Christian Dior shares Agache does not own. The Arnault family will offer a price to be defined based on the LVMH share price.

item.title: Trump expected to award science medal to SpaceX's Elon Musk, Fox News reports
item.description: US President Donald Trump is expected to award the National Medal of Science to SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, Fox News reported.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump is expected to award the National Medal of Science to SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, Fox News reported. The National Medal of Science is the nation's highest honor for scientists and engineers, according to the US National Science Foundation's website. Google (GOOGL.O) co-founder Sergey Brin, Nvidia (NVDA.O) CEO Jensen Huang and AMD CEO Lisa Su will also receive the award, according to Fox News. Dell Technologies CEO Michael Dell and Microsoft (MSFT.O) CEO Satya Nadella will receive the National Medal of Technology and Innovation, the nation’s highest honor for technological achievement, according to the US Patent and Trademark Office's website.

item.title: Exportação de carne do Brasil cai 35% em setembro apesar de fortes embarques aos EUA, diz Abiec
item.description: As exportações de carne bovina do Brasil caíram 35,1% em setembro, com impacto da barreira tarifária chinesa, enquanto maiores embarques aos Estados Unidos e União Europeia evitaram um recuo ainda mais acentuado, apontaram nesta quarta-feira dados divulgados pela associação do setor Abiec.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: As exportações de carne bovina do Brasil caíram 35,1% em setembro, com impacto da barreira tarifária chinesa, enquanto maiores embarques aos Estados Unidos e União Europeia evitaram um recuo ainda mais acentuado, apontaram nesta quarta-feira dados divulgados pela associação do setor Abiec. Maior produtor e exportador global, o Brasil embarcou 229,3 mil toneladas de carne bovina no mês passado, com uma redução de 93,2% nas exportações à China, para 12,9 mil toneladas, uma vez que se esgotou a cota com tarifa reduzida estabelecida pelo maior importador mundial. De outro lado, os envios aos Estados Unidos somaram 48,3 mil toneladas, salto de 389% em relação ao mesmo mês de 2025, segundo a Abiec, o que se explica pela base mais fraca de comparação devido ao tarifaço no ano passado e também por uma recente condição mais vantajosa para exportadores acessarem o mercado norte-americano. Em agosto, o presidente norte-americano, Donald Trump, assinou documento para aumentar temporariamente a quantidade de carne bovina magra importada pelos EUA, com eliminação temporária de tarifa extracota de 26,4% para 300 mil toneladas, divididas em três meses. A demanda dos EUA tem sido crescente para suprir um mercado com escassez de animais. Já os embarques do Brasil para a União Europeia atingiram 20 mil toneladas em setembro, avanço anual de 29,7%, pois empresas correram para certificar produção antes de 3 de setembro, quando venceu o prazo para o início de um embargo europeu ao produto brasileiro. Após o Brasil não atender exigências do bloco europeu sobre antimicrobianos, a UE retirou o país de uma lista de autorizações, o que indica que as exportações nos próximos meses ficarão dependentes de uma decisão europeia. RETOMADA DA CHINA A redução para os embarques à China deixou as exportações brasileiras no acumulado de janeiro a setembro em queda de 0,5% em relação ao mesmo período do ano passado, para 2,43 milhões de toneladas de carne bovina. A receita com as exportações no ano somou US$14,17 bilhões, crescimento de 14,1% na mesma comparação, disse a Abiec. Mas, com a aproximação do fim do ano, a indústria já se prepara para as negociações e os embarques destinados ao próximo ciclo da cota chinesa de 1,128 milhão de toneladas, com tarifa reduzida para 12% -- acima disso, a taxa passa para 55%. Os embarques para a cota de 2027 começam em novembro, de acordo com a Abiec.

item.title: Ronaldo hails Messi after Argentina great says he already misses national team
item.description: Portugal captain Cristiano Ronaldo set aside one of soccer's great rivalries on Wednesday to pay tribute to Lionel Messi after the Argentine said he already missed representing his country following his emotional international retirement.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Portugal captain Cristiano Ronaldo set aside one of soccer's great rivalries on Wednesday to pay tribute to Lionel Messi after the Argentine said he already missed representing his country following his emotional international retirement. Messi, 39, delivered one [USN:L1N45T01T TEXT:"final masterclass"] in Argentina's blue and white on Tuesday, scoring once and setting up two goals in a 3-0 friendly win over Benin before more than 85,000 fans at Buenos Aires' Monumental Stadium, where his farewell became a celebration of an extraordinary 21-year international career. "Yesterday was my last game, and I already miss wearing the blue and white. I know I'm making the right decision," Messi said in a lengthy Instagram post. "It's been an incredible journey, full of joy and also some sadness, but I know for sure that every step I took was worth it... "I don't want to forget Diego (Maradona), who put our country where it deserved to be and who, as I always say, I know helped us both by being here with us and also from heaven, with every step we took. "Thank you to the clubs where I played, for always respecting my feelings and allowing me to dedicate myself to my country whenever it was time to put on the national team jersey..." Messi captained Argentina to the 2022 World Cup title and Copa America triumphs in 2021 and 2024, while also helping them win the 2022 Finalissima. "I am grateful. I love you all very much; I'm going to miss you, and I will always thank you for having been by our side, by my side," the Inter Miami playmaker added. Messi and Ronaldo have vied for recognition as the greatest player of their generation throughout their illustrious careers, with the 41-year-old Portuguese forward among those to respond to the post. "Leo, after so many years of defending your country, you've made history that will last forever. I have the utmost respect for what you've accomplished with Argentina. A hug," Ronaldo said. Ronaldo, meanwhile, is [USN:L6N45S178 TEXT:"embroiled in a dispute"] with Portugal coach Jorge Jesus following his abrupt departure from the national team's training camp.

item.title: CDC considera baixo o risco de peste e monitora chegadas da Sibéria, diz diretora
item.description: A diretora do Centro de Controle e Prevenção de Doenças (CDC) dos Estados Unidos, Erica Schwartz, afirmou nesta quarta-feira que o risco decorrente de um caso não confirmado de peste pneumônica na Sibéria é extremamente baixo para os EUA, mas a agência está preparada para monitorar e fazer uma triagem dos viajantes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A diretora do Centro de Controle e Prevenção de Doenças (CDC) dos Estados Unidos, Erica Schwartz, afirmou nesta quarta-feira que o risco decorrente de um caso não confirmado de peste pneumônica na Sibéria é extremamente baixo para os EUA, mas a agência está preparada para monitorar e fazer uma triagem dos viajantes. “Estamos trabalhando com o Departamento de Segurança Interna, com o Departamento de Estado, o Departamento de Guerra e outras agências do governo para garantir que saibamos exatamente se alguém daquela região entrar nos Estados Unidos”, disse Schwartz no evento “O Futuro da Saúde”, organizado pelo Wall Street Journal em Washington. O CDC possui um posto de saúde no Aeroporto Internacional John F. Kennedy que pode realizar vigilância e triagem de viajantes da região que entram nos Estados Unidos, acrescentou. O Departamento de Saúde e Serviços Humanos dos EUA não respondeu imediatamente se a agência planeja estabelecer triagem no JFK. Schwartz disse que há cerca de 200 voos por ano provenientes da região da Sibéria, embora voos diretos entre a Rússia e os EUA tenham sido suspensos desde o início da guerra na Ucrânia, em 2022. O órgão regulador de saúde da Rússia afirmou que não há riscos de uma epidemia na Sibéria após a morte de uma funcionária do instituto de peste local por pneumonia de origem ainda não determinada, em um caso que gerou preocupação internacional. “O que estamos fazendo, de uma perspectiva governamental ampla, é garantir que entendamos exatamente qual é essa ameaça”, disse Schwartz. “Estamos muito confiantes de que a ameaça para os Estados Unidos é extremamente baixa.” O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, também disse a jornalistas não acreditar que a morte tenha sido causada por uma arma biológica.

item.title: Trump dice que a la Junta de la Reserva Federal le gustaría que al país le fuera mal
item.description: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, consultado el miércoles sobre las tasas hipotecarias, dijo que la Junta de la Reserva Federal "querría que al país le fuera mal".
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, consultado el miércoles sobre las tasas hipotecarias, dijo que la Junta de la Reserva Federal "querría que al país le fuera mal". La tasa hipotecaria a 30 años alcanzó la semana pasada su nivel más alto en casi tres años. Trump calificó de "magnífico" al presidente de la Fed, Kevin Warsh, pero añadió que al resto de la junta "le gustaría que al país le vaya mal, en mi opinión, porque creo que las tasas de interés deberían bajar". El secretario del Tesoro de Estados Unidos, Scott Bessent, presente en el Despacho Oval junto a Trump, dijo que la inflación era alta debido a la "crisis energética". "Así que, una vez que superemos este conflicto con Irán, el mercado energético estará bien abastecido, y nos acercaremos al objetivo de la Reserva Federal, y tanto las tasas hipotecarias como la tasa a 10 años volverán a bajar", añadió Bessent.

item.title: EPA says will rescind policy targeting oil and gas industry methane leaks
item.description: The US Environmental Protection Agency on Wednesday said it is days away from proposing to rescind a Biden-era policy that sought to rein in large leaks of methane, a potent greenhouse gas, from oil and gas operations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US Environmental Protection Agency on Wednesday said it is days away from proposing to rescind a Biden-era policy that sought to rein in large leaks of methane, a potent greenhouse gas, from oil and gas operations. The move is part of a broad Trump administration effort to slash regulations that it says burden US businesses as it seeks to boost domestic fossil fuel production. "Americans must be able to afford to heat their homes in the winter and fill up their car and drive to work. They can’t do that when the people producing the energy are weighed down by unnecessary burdens," EPA Administrator Lee Zeldin said in a statement. EPA said its proposal would save $45 billion a year. EPA's "super emitter" program requires companies to react when third parties report suspected methane leaks using remote sensing. Methane is the second-biggest cause of climate change after carbon dioxide, and the oil and gas industry is a major source of the gas.

item.content:encoded: Estados Unidos anunció el miércoles que había incautado 90 envíos distintos de biodiésel con destino a Cuba por un valor de casi 3 millones de dólares, la segunda vez en una semana que Washington anuncia la incautación de combustible "ilegal" que se dirigía a la isla. Estas medidas se producen mientras Washington sigue asfixiando el sector energético cubano, permitiendo que solo lleguen al sector privado de la isla envíos relativamente pequeños de combustible, en el marco de un programa destinado a debilitar al Gobierno cubano. El agente especial al mando del Departamento de Seguridad Nacional en Miami, José Figueroa, declaró a la prensa que los envíos incautados tenían como destino Enetec, una empresa estatal de combustible con sede en La Habana sancionada por Estados Unidos a principios de este año. Las autoridades afirmaron que habían interceptado los envíos de combustible en Houston y en Port Everglades, en el sur de Florida. Se incautaron más de 600.000 galones de combustible, informó el Departamento de Seguridad Nacional. "Una operación de esta magnitud para eludir las sanciones de EEUU no se produce por casualidad", afirmó Figueroa. "Estas acciones se refieren a envíos sospechosos de beneficiar al régimen cubano a través de una entidad controlada por el Estado". El Gobierno de Cuba no se pronunció de inmediato sobre la incautación de combustible. El bloqueo de combustible impuesto por Washington a Cuba ha sido calificado de "ilegal" por las Naciones Unidas y de "guerra económica" por el Gobierno comunista de Cuba. Ha agravado enormemente los cortes de electricidad, la escasez de agua y la inflación en toda la isla.

item.title: Evicted Spanish octogenarian Maricarmen Abascal, heart of Spain's housing protests, has died
item.description: Maricarmen Abascal, the 87-year-old woman whose dramatic eviction last month sparked mass housing protests in Spain that ultimately led to an early election, has died, Madrid's tenants' union said on Wednesday, provoking an outpouring of grief and anger on the streets of the capital.
item.dc:creator: Pietro Lombardi, Corina Pons
item.content:encoded: Maricarmen Abascal, the 87-year-old woman whose [USN:L8N45F0PQ TEXT:"dramatic eviction"] last month sparked mass housing protests in Spain that ultimately led to an early election, has died, Madrid's tenants' union said on Wednesday, provoking an outpouring of grief and anger on the streets of the capital. Abascal had been in hospital since her eviction on September 23 from her home of more than 70 years, when police and social workers removed her by stretcher. Since then, protests have included activists camping out on one of Madrid's main squares and calls for action over a mounting housing crisis including a shortage of homes and surging rents. Following the news of Abascal's death, thousands marched from the square, Puerta del Sol, towards parliament, chanting: "This is not a death. It's a murder!" A cause of death was not announced. Trade unions on Wednesday [USN:L1N45T0BN TEXT:"announced"] there will be a nationwide general strike over housing issues on November 11. The protests, along with [USN:L1N45O0BD TEXT:"parliament's rejection last week"] of decrees aimed at curbing evictions and limiting rent pressures, prompted Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez to call an [USN:L8N45R05N TEXT:"early election"] for November 29. Sanchez is seeking to shift the political narrative from his government's [USN:L1N4510WI TEXT:"handling of a migrant crisis"] in Spain's North African enclave of Ceuta and a [USN:L1N42U0KB TEXT:"series of corruption cases"] involving his Socialist Party and his family to the housing crisis, an area in which he can harness growing resentment about rising rents. "Now, following her passing, we are left with the example of the fight she waged and the legacy Maricarmen has left behind. And, above all, we will honor what she always asked of us: 'Fight, keep fighting for what is yours,'" the tenants' union said in a statement. Sanchez posted on X, lamenting Abascal's death. "A hug as well to all of us who feel this loss as our own today," he wrote. Angel Victor Torres, Spain's territorial policy minister, said Abascal had become a symbol of what was happening to many families as elderly and young people struggled to obtain their own homes or stay in them.

item.title: US seizes $3 million in fuel shipments to Cuba as crackdown continues
item.description: The US said on Wednesday it had seized 90 separate shipments of biodiesel bound for Cuba worth nearly $3 million, the second time in a week US authorities have announced the seizure of "illegal" fuel en route to the island nation.
item.dc:creator: Dave Sherwood
item.content:encoded: The US said on Wednesday it had seized 90 separate shipments of biodiesel bound for Cuba worth nearly $3 million, the second time in a week US authorities have announced the seizure of "illegal" fuel en route to the island nation. The enforcement action comes as the Trump administration continues to strangle Cuba's energy sector, allowing only relatively small shipments of fuel to reach the island's private sector in a [USN:L1N409065 TEXT:"program aimed at undercutting the Cuban government"]. The Department of Homeland Security Miami Special Agent in Charge Jose Figueroa told reporters in Miami on Wednesday that the seized shipments were bound for Enetec, a Havana-based, state-owned fuel company sanctioned by the US earlier this year. Authorities said they had intercepted the fuel shipments in Houston and at Port Everglades, in south Florida, before they departed the US. More than 600,000 gallons of fuel were seized, Homeland Security said. "An effort of this magnitude to undermine US sanctions does not occur by accident," Figueroa said. "These actions concern shipments suspected of benefiting the Cuban regime through a state-controlled entity. "Those who seek to undermine US law to finance, facilitate or benefit from such efforts should be on notice." Cuba`s government did not immediately comment on the fuel seizure. The Trump administration's fuel blockade on Cuba has been called "illegal" [USN:L1N41K1TL TEXT:"by the United Nations"] and "economic warfare" by Cuba`s communist-run government. It has vastly worsened ongoing blackouts, water shortages and inflation across the island, pushing the island toward a humanitarian crisis. US President Donald Trump has openly stated that his goal with the blockade and sanctions is to upend Cuba's government. The US Coast Guard [USN:L1N45O0GT TEXT:"late last week announced that it had intercepted"] a large container ship in September carrying fuel bound for Cuba. It said the ship had attempted to evade authorities and that it carried large quantities of fuel hidden in its ballast tanks. The US has not revealed the identity of the exporters in either case.

item.title: Trump says he may ask FBI to look into Nolan Wells death
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Wednesday said he was considering asking the FBI to look into the death of an 18-year-old Black man whose body was found on a Mississippi barrier island following a Fourth of July trip with friends.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump on Wednesday said he was considering asking the FBI to look into the death of an 18-year-old Black man whose body was found on a Mississippi barrier island following a Fourth of July trip with friends. Asked by reporters at the White House whether he planned to push the FBI to launch an independent investigation into the death of Nolan Wells, Trump said: "Well, we're looking at that. Yes, we are." Trump's comments come after the family of the teenager called earlier this week for a [USN:L1N45S026 TEXT:"federal investigation"] into his death after a grand jury declined to indict anyone. Wells' body was found on July 6 on the northwest end of Horn Island, a barrier island off the Mississippi Gulf Coast, after he went missing during a Fourth of July weekend trip with friends from nearby Ocean Springs. The case developed drew national scrutiny. Although authorities had not alleged foul play, questions were raised in the weeks after his death by family members, civil rights leaders and others about transparency, accountability and disparities in attention to cases involving Black victims. Last month, a grand jury unanimously [USN:L1N45E02K TEXT:"declined to indict anyone"] in the death. Jackson County District Attorney Angel Myers McIlrath said there was no evidence to support allegations that Wells' disappearance and death were racially motivated.

item.title: US FCC to vote to ban all Chinese labs from testing US electronics
item.description: The Federal Communications Commission said on Wednesday it will vote on October 29 to bar all Chinese labs from testing electronic devices such as smartphones, cameras and computers for use in the US, widening a previous action targeting Beijing.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: The Federal Communications Commission said on Wednesday it will vote on October 29 to bar all Chinese labs from testing electronic devices such as smartphones, cameras and computers for use in the US, widening a previous action targeting Beijing. The FCC said it will prohibit test labs and certification bodies in countries including China that deny reciprocal treatment to US-based test labs. FCC Chair Brendan Carr said in 2025, 82% of electronics were tested in China, which does not have an agreement with the US. The FCC prohibitions are slated to take effect in December 2028. In 2025, the FCC banned testing of US electronics by labs owned or controlled by the Chinese government, and several dozen labs were barred. But the agency said this year that a substantial majority of China-based test labs were still testing US electronics. "Less than 4% of all electronic devices are tested in labs located inside the US," FCC Chair Brendan Carr said, adding the FCC will "insist on fair and reciprocal treatment in international commerce." Separately, the FCC is adopting a streamlined approval process for devices tested in US labs or labs from countries not posing national security risks. This is the latest move by Washington to crack down on China over technology issues and equipment. In December, the FCC banned the import of all new models of Chinese drones and also has banned imports of new models of Chinese-made consumer routers, the boxes connecting computers, phones and smart devices to the internet. The FCC previously barred some Chinese companies from providing telecommunications services in the US on national security concerns. In July, the FCC voted to bar sales of devices in the US that contain key hardware from Chinese companies deemed to be national security risks and has proposed to prohibit US telecommunications carriers from interconnecting with Chinese telecom firms deemed national security risks. The FCC maintains a list of firms, including Chinese telecom company Huawei and ZTE (000063.SZ) , whose equipment is barred for sale in the US due to national security concerns. In June, the FCC banned the import of more equipment from a group of Chinese manufacturers including Huawei and ZTE and has proposed to ban the import of most military-grade drones.

item.title: Cade aprova compra de participação minoritária da Azul pela American Airlines
item.description: O Conselho Administrativo de Defesa Econômica (Cade) aprovou a aquisição pela American Airlines de participação minoritária de aproximadamente 8% no capital social da Azul , segundo nota publicada pelo órgão nesta quarta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Conselho Administrativo de Defesa Econômica (Cade) aprovou a aquisição pela American Airlines (AAL.O) de participação minoritária de aproximadamente 8% no capital social da Azul (AZUL3.SA) , segundo nota publicada pelo órgão nesta quarta-feira. A operação envolve investimento de US$100 milhões no contexto da reestruturação financeira da Azul sob o processo de recuperação judicial sob o Chapter 11 nos Estados Unidos, disse o Cade. "Durante a tramitação no Tribunal, a instrução foi complementada em paralelo às tratativas relativas ao Acordo em Controle de Concentrações, considerando as especificidades temporais da operação e o contexto de reestruturação financeira da Azul. As requerentes colaboraram com a apresentação das informações e a construção das salvaguardas necessárias à aprovação", disse o órgão. Segundo o Cade, com a decisão, a operação fica aprovada condicionada à celebração e ao integral cumprimento do Acordo em Controle de Concentrações.

item.title: GPA diz que tribunal de SP homologou plano de recuperação extrajudicial; ação sobe 9%
item.description: O GPA informou nesta quata-feira que o Juízo da 3ª Vara de Falências e Recuperações Judiciais do Foro Central da Comarca de São Paulo homologou o plano de recuperação extrajudicial da companhia, segundo fato relevante divulgado ao mercado.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O GPA (PCAR3.SA) informou nesta quata-feira que o Juízo da 3ª Vara de Falências e Recuperações Judiciais do Foro Central da Comarca de São Paulo homologou o plano de recuperação extrajudicial da companhia, segundo fato relevante divulgado ao mercado. O plano abrange os créditos quirografários não relacionados a operações correntes de fornecimento de produtos, mercadorias, prestação de serviços ou aluguéis (Créditos Sujeitos), no montante total de R$4,568 bilhões, afirmou a empresa. O GPA teve a adesão de credores titulares de 57,49% dos Créditos Sujeitos, percentual superior à maioria exigida, segundo o documento. A emprea afirmou que dará sequência aos atos necessários à implementação do plano, entre eles a celebração dos instrumentos relativos aos novos recursos, com captação de R$200 milhões, e dos instrumentos relativos aos créditos sujeitos. Às 15h54, as ações do GPA ON (PCAR3.SA) subiam 8,9% na bolsa paulista, enquanto o índice Ibovespa recuava 0,21%, a 205.396,21 pontos.

item.title: Britain's BBC, Channel 4 discuss broader tie-up to cut costs, sources say
item.description: Britain's BBC and Channel 4 have held preliminary talks with the government about a broader tie-up of some operations, two people with direct knowledge of the discussions said, in a potential shake-up of the country's public broadcasters.
item.dc:creator: Amy-Jo Crowley
item.content:encoded: Britain's BBC and Channel 4 have held preliminary talks with the government about a broader tie-up of some operations, two people with direct knowledge of the discussions said, in a potential shake-up of the country's public broadcasters. One option under discussion would combine Channel 4's advertising operations, channels including E4 and Film4, and its video-on-demand services, with UKTV, a commercial subsidiary of the BBC, the people told Reuters. A merged entity could be equally owned by the BBC and Channel 4 and represent a broader tie-up than the one previously indicated by BBC Director General Matt Brittin to include Channel 4 content in the BBC's iPlayer, the people said. The talks could intensify next year depending on what progress the BBC makes towards [USN:L8N43G0OI TEXT:"a new funding deal"] with the government, one of the people said, adding that the assets included in the potential joint venture could be expanded. The joint venture under consideration would not include the Channel 4 flagship broadcast channel, which could benefit from fees from the joint venture, the people said. The move would be aimed at cutting costs and helping secure the future of the public broadcasters as linear viewing declines and larger streaming companies [USN:L6N43U0UJ TEXT:"account for more"] of global advertising spend, the people said. A BBC spokesperson declined to comment. "But as we've said before we believe increased collaboration between all (public service broadcasters) is vital to ensure the industry thrives in a highly competitive global market place," the BBC spokesperson said. A Channel 4 spokesperson said: "We won't be commenting on any speculation but we welcome and support greater collaboration between Public Service Media and strongly believe working together can strengthen impact, innovation and sustainability in UK broadcasting. Channel 4 and the BBC already have a successful commercial relationship, involving ad sales for UKTV and the carriage of U on 4Streaming." Channel 4 is government-owned but funded by advertisements, while the publicly owned BBC is mainly funded by a licence paid by TV-watching households. The talks involve UK Government Investments (UKGI), the entity responsible for managing publicly owned assets such as Channel 4, the people said. The plans could help Channel 4 and the BBC save costs, bringing some operations under one management and gaining a bigger slice of a consolidating market, the people said. UKGI declined to comment. DISCUSSING A DEEPER TIE-UP If it went ahead, such a move would represent one of the biggest shake-ups for the broadcasters since Britain [USN:S8N31X084 TEXT:"scrapped"] plans to sell Channel 4 in 2023. Former Prime Minister Boris Johnson's government had announced the sale in 2022, triggering a backlash from lawmakers and the broadcasting industry. The two broadcasters had already been discussing partnerships around content sharing, such as a [USN:L8N45L0ZF TEXT:"potential plan"] to carry Channel 4 content on iPlayer. Channel 4 already carries UKTV content such as "The Office" and "Red Dwarf" on its streaming platform and manages ad sales for UKTV under a long-standing agreement. While it has ruled out merging with the BBC, it is open to sharing content on the iPlayer streaming service, Channel 4's CEO Priya Dogra [USN:L8N45L0ZF TEXT:"said at an industry event last month"]. Channel 4 and the BBC are pursuing cost-cutting, including through job reductions. The BBC [USN:L8N42P0X7 TEXT:"said"] in June it would cut 550 jobs as part of plans under [USN:SPN40B000 TEXT:"Brittin"] to save £500 million ($661 million) over the next three years. Channel 4, which cut its pre-tax deficit to £10 million in 2025, said last month it would cut about 340 jobs, representing more than a quarter of its workforce, in one of the biggest rounds of redundancies in its 43-year history. It also said it agreed a tie-up of its ad sales operations with Paramount-Skydance's Channel 5, another public service broadcaster. ($1 = 0.7569 pounds)

item.title: Pressure mounting on Cornell administration, president over handling of alleged gang rape
item.description: Cornell University’s administration and president are facing mounting pressure over the school’s handling of an alleged 2024 gang rape that has thrust it into the national spotlight and set off a wave of outrage over sexual violence on college campuses.
item.dc:creator: Helen Coster
item.content:encoded: Cornell University’s administration and president are facing mounting pressure over the school’s handling of an alleged 2024 gang rape that has thrust it into the national spotlight and set off a wave of outrage over sexual violence on college campuses. Since Monday, the administration has faced student protests , a no-confidence resolution from faculty, and criticism by alumni. A seven-hour sit-in in support of the alleged victim is planned for Wednesday. Representatives for University President Michael Kotlikoff and Cornell did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Kotlikoff released a video statement over the weekend in which he said "we must do better" and the school would take "a serious look at the role of fraternities and sororities in campus life." Still, calls have mounted among some [USN:L1N45S00N TEXT:"demonstrators"] for the resignation of Kotlikoff and members of his administration, blaming their policies for what protesters have described as a "culture of rape" on campus. The demonstrators also want an external inquiry into how Cornell's administration has handled the matter, independent hearings and uniform minimum sanctions for all sexual assaults on campus, as well as better training for campus police in responding to complaints of sexual violence and harassment. The Cornell Faculty Senate, which represents faculty members in university governance, introduced a resolution this week calling for a no-confidence vote in the administration’s handling of the school’s “ongoing crisis of sexual assault.” The resolution will be debated at the Senate’s October 14 meeting. Alumni are also voicing concern. In an open letter to Kotlikoff and the university's Board of Trustees, posted on the Cornell Daily Sun website, alumnus Marco Fuentes wrote that the president and trustees had “single-handedly degraded" the school's reputation and "eroded the value of the degrees earned by tens of thousands of proud alumni” through their “administrative negligence and spineless handling” of the alleged assault. Fuentes wrote that he will no longer bequeath half his estate to the school, and is contacting alumni and donor networks to advocate for a freeze on donations until leadership changes occur. The outcry began last month with a lawsuit in which the alleged victim, referred to as "Jane Doe", said she was plied with drugs and alcohol and sexually assaulted by several members of the campus chapter of the Chi Phi fraternity in October 2024 after she became incapacitated. She reported the alleged assault to police several weeks after the fact, leading to an internal university investigation and a law enforcement probe, but the local prosecutor declined to bring criminal charges in the case. Cornell, which has defended its response to the original report, shut down the Chi Phi chapter and imposed a range of discipline on the fraternity members involved, including expulsions and other sanctions. The alleged victim’s lawsuit criticized the university for having offered some of the alleged perpetrators a chance to mitigate their penalties by writing essays. The men all denied any wrongdoing, some saying the sexual activity was consensual and others disputing their participation, the New York Times has reported, citing Cornell documents. Cornell said this week it [USN:L6N45S15B TEXT:"hired"] a top former US Justice Department lawyer to conduct an independent review of how Cornell prevents and responds to sexual assault claims.

item.title: Trump diz que Diretoria do Federal Reserve gostaria de ver o país passar por dificuldades
item.description: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, questionado por um repórter na quarta-feira sobre as taxas de hipotecas, afirmou que a Diretoria do Federal Reserve “gostaria de ver o país passar por dificuldades”.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, questionado por um repórter na quarta-feira sobre as taxas de hipotecas, afirmou que a Diretoria do Federal Reserve “gostaria de ver o país passar por dificuldades”. A taxa de hipotecas de 30 anos atingiu, na semana passada, seu nível mais alto em quase três anos. Trump chamou o chair do Fed, Kevin Warsh, de “ótimo”, mas acrescentou que o restante da diretoria “gostaria de ver o país em má situação, na minha opinião, porque acho que as taxas de juros deveriam cair”. O secretário do Tesouro dos EUA, Scott Bessent, que estava no Salão Oval com Trump, disse que a inflação estava alta devido ao “choque energético”. "Assim que deixarmos para trás esse conflito com o Irã, o mercado de energia estará bem abastecido, e avançaremos em direção à meta do Fed. As taxas de hipoteca e os rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro de 10 anos voltarão a cair", acrescentou Bessent.

item.title: Islanders D Alexander Romanov (ACL) out 6-8 months
item.description: New York Islanders defenseman Alexander Romanov will be sidelined six to eight months after sustaining a torn ACL in his right knee, the team announced Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: New York Islanders defenseman Alexander Romanov will be sidelined six to eight months after sustaining a torn ACL in his right knee, the team announced Wednesday. Romanov sustained the injury during a collision with Mika Zibanejad in the third period of the Islanders' 5-2 setback to the New York Rangers on Tuesday. He owns a plus-2 rating without a point in three games this season. Romanov, 26, sat out the bulk of last season after undergoing surgery on his shoulder following an injury in a game against the Dallas Stars on Nov. 18. He has totaled 84 points (17 goals, 67 assists) in 372 career games with the Montreal Canadiens (2020-22) and Islanders. He was selected by the Canadiens in the second round of the 2018 NHL Draft. --Field Level Media

item.title: Anglo-Teck merger, nickel sale are test cases for navigating geopolitical complexities, CEO says
